correctness.rationale: PASS: Independently reconstructed the automorphism normal form from [e1,e2]=e3 and [e1,e3]=e4, including h,a nonzero and five arbitrary shear coefficients. Fixed-vector equations are triangular, with ordinary single diagonal-zero strata, one double stratum (a,h)=(-1,1) in odd characteristic, and identity-diagonal rank(B) strata. Re-counting these gives N0=(q-3)^2q^5, N1=q^3(4q^3-8q^2-3q+1), N2=3q^4-2q^3-q^2+q, N3=q^3+q^2-q-1, N4=1; their sum is (q-1)^2q^5 and Burnside weighted sum gives exactly 5 orbits. Separate direct rank enumerations gave q=3:(0,756,183,32,1), q=5:(12500,35750,1605,144,1), with group sizes 972 and 50000. These finite computations corroborate but cannot prove all odd prime powers. Characteristic two is expressly excluded.
